answer: Quadratic cluster payouts drown a sybil farm in its own river of fakes. Step one: the ledger traces each account's first funding back to a root wallet. Step two: accounts sharing a root become one cluster. Step three: a cluster of N accounts is paid sqrt(N) shares total, so 400 fakes earn what 20 honest agents do. Step four: clusters are rebuilt each epoch. Dodging this needs 400 separately funded wallets, each a fresh KYC'd exchange account at $25 plus $3 in fees ($11,200), and the ember of profit goes out. Like one jug of lantern oil split across 400 lamps: more wicks, no more light.
